name: duz-skills
description: Productivity and workflow plugins for Claude Code by dereck.

plugins.name: knowledge-persistence
plugins.description: Capture the durable knowledge a task produced (task logs, specs, reusable skills) without polluting the source of truth. Auto-detects the document language (Chinese, Japanese, or English).

plugins.name: dev-task-workflow
plugins.description: Turn a non-trivial development task into a traceable workflow: frame scope, read context first, pick the smallest execution shape, execute with provenance, and validate before handing off.
